expected_level_description: You can: - explain what clinical coding is and why it matters - use basic medical terms and anatomy
You can: - explain the difference between a clinical terminology and a classification - recognise common terminologies such as SNOMED CT and ICD
You can: - file, find, and track records correctly - protect records from loss or unauthorised access
You can: - explain why accurate health data matters for care and planning - record data accurately and report errors
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
